name: Empty
summary: The placeholder for a surface that has no data yet.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-empty> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; a line-art illustration, a short caption (the default slot) and an optional action (slot="action"). A static marker — no interactive state, so no motion. Zero drift — the same element.
codeNote: The illustration is the component's own line-art graphic, drawn with currentColor from a token-bound host colour — not a catalogue glyph. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: (default slot)
props.desc: The caption describing why the surface is empty

props.name: action
props.desc: An optional call to action (a button or link)

whenToUse.when: a list, table, or panel has nothing to show yet
reporting the outcome of an action (success, 404)

opinion.note: The caption says what's missing and, ideally, the next step — 'No responses yet — share the join link'. Keep one action; an empty state is a nudge, not a menu.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3's measured set has no Empty cell; spec derived from the token layer (text-tertiary, text-disabled) + antd Empty conventions (centred line-art placeholder). A deliberate, documented extension — not a measured match.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render.
